description.text:
One of the fastest growing British jewellery brands, Monica Vinader has taken the accessible luxury jewellery market by storm, successfully bridging the gap between fine and fashion jewellery to gain a strong following across a wide range of customers. Born out of a love of eye-catching, colourful jewellery and inspired by travel, the brand was formed with the desire to create beautiful pieces that can be worn every day.

From iconic friendship bracelets to vibrant gemstones and attainable diamonds, collections are extremely versatile. The brand empowers individuality, encouraging customers to mix, stack and layer pieces to create their own personal styles.

The second Monica Vinader London boutique, the Canary Wharf, Jubilee Place store is designed to reflect the brand's love of materials and provide a joyful shopping experience. With a dedicated in store engraving service, this is the go-to destination for same day, complimentary engraving, providing the ultimate in customisation to add a bespoke finish, or create the perfect gift.

Make it your own: Get your name, message or doodle set in gold with complimentary engraving every Thursday 4-8pm with free champagne and styling advice

Location: Jubilee Place
